name: Vacuum extension 100 mm
description: Short hollow extension for the hand vacuum, replacing the long brush extension: a 65 mm tube (36 x 20 mm) with a 35 mm push-in plug (31.8 x 15.8 mm, 2 mm walls) and a straight air channel. The plug has a 45 degree lead-in and two small crush ribs on each wide face (0.4 mm) so it grips the nozzle by friction; the wider tube stops against the nozzle. Prints standing on its wide end with no supports (PETG or PLA, 3 perimeters). SIZES ARE ESTIMATED from a photo: measure the nozzle opening and set HOLE_W / HOLE_H in vacuum_extension.py (now 32 x 16 mm). Print the short fit test first. Not printed or fitted.
